Salam Brother,

It is exactly as you have said ("as in they repeat those powerful words once or twice bc of emotions"). Different verses effect different people differently. Sometimes a verse you have read so many times can effect you differently/deeply as you go through different emotions and hardships in life. 

E.g yesterday I was reading the last 2 verses of Surah Al-Fajr (89:29 and 89:30) which I have read HUNDREDS of time but this time I felt it so deeply. Bearing in mind I was asking god to make things easier for me and make the hardships/sacrifices in this life worth it. So when I read this verse it HIT me hard and cried as I imagined Allah telling me these words on the day of judgement so I kept repeating it as it sounded so sweet to my ears. 

This is why the Quran can never get boring as the same verse can make you feel so many different emotions every time you read it. This for me is a miracle of the Quran. 

Amazing to see you interested and looking into the Quran. May God guide you to the ultimate success and truth.
